description: This file defines a CMake macro 'CreateDepPackage' that automates the creation of a Debian package (DEB) for a software component. It handles setting package metadata such as name, version, description, maintainer, dependencies, and components, and configures CPack for packaging.

methods.name: CreateDepPackage
methods.description: A macro that creates a Debian package with specified components, metadata, and dependencies, using CPack.
